initialization.duration: uniform positive full ages1..260 for all arms
initialization.estimated_emissions: same deterministic training-only 1D Lloyd20 initialized at quantiles0.125/0.375/0.625/0.875, observed cluster population variance, sorted initial means
initialization.empty_cluster: retain center; global observed variance for fewer than2 members
initialization.known_control: known generating means/variance; separate reference, not initialization-matched to estimated arms

fit.joint_updates: soft posterior occupancy-weighted Gaussian means/variances plus same augmented fixed-bin duration M-step
fit.estimated_frozen: learn duration only with observation-estimated emission parameters held fixed

evaluation.primary: joint versus frozen estimated arms; identical observations and initial PMF/emission parameters
evaluation.baseline: uniform duration with each arm's initial emission parameters; joint gain includes emission learning
evaluation.alignment: post-fit mean-sorted state permutation for recovery metrics only; do not relabel model/transition parameters during training
evaluation.outer_and_truth: only after all three fits; no ground-truth support or labels in initialization/fitting

integrity: freeze complete runner/config/software/source/protocol hashes before fresh fits
resume exact PMF/means/variances and completed update count
independent terminal/outer likelihood, all-parameter gradient and causal filter replay
ground-truth episode exposure is post-fit only
no changing seeds/initialization/family/budgets/gates after outer outcomes
limitations: scalar Gaussian and fixed duration bins, known transition/initial; no joint-neural/Trading or legacy NPZ acceptance
known control changes emission information and is not an initialization-matched learning comparison
bounded EM is not a global convergence guarantee
no Adam comparison or optimizer selection in this study
